comment: If you take this class, make sure that you can do all the readings. If you don't do the readings, there's no way you can do well on the pop quizzes. Also, her tests are confusing in the way that they're worded. In comparison to other Soc classes, this class has a lot of work!
She gives many pop quizzes but is not clear or straight to the point in what she teaches.
Worst core prof I've had yet. Poor explanations and pop quizzes. Avoid.

Great professor.  Interesting topic, does give pop quizes.  Not hard to do well in this class. Interesting fact: she took us on a prison tour.  You should be interested in the topic of deviance, however to enjoy the course

Class was usually interesting and discussion was relaxed. Tests were very straightforward. Tough grader on papers. It wasn't necessary to do all the readings but she does give pop quizzes. Willing to be flexible with due dates. Overall a great class.

Briddell is an excellent professor. She is fair and willing to change around due dates if it is reasonable. I found the tests to be easy and homework was only about one hour of reading for each class period. Her classes cover interesting topics. She is tough when it comes to papers though

She is a great professor. She is very clear and concise in her lectures. She manages to incorporate the readings into the lecture without spoon-feeding the information. She is the best professor I have had at this university.

She's what you'd expect from a sociology professor. Easy to get off topic, but then again the class isn't very linear. As a math-science guy, it was just tolerable. Important tip: she likes her papers clear and to the point. Do the readings. There are little pop quizzes here and there. Class participation is a thing. Test are kinda difficult.

Prof. Briddell expects her students to engage themselves and read/do the assigned work. She is not difficult to understand if you're actually listening and I enjoyed her class. I would take a class by her again. If you work hard, her class won't be too challenging OR too easy.
The type of teacher to give a quiz about the readings on a Monday 9am
I found Ms. Briddell to be one of the least accomplished and professional employees I have encountered at UR. It's a miracle she still gets a paycheck.
Laine is a pretty solid teacher. Sociology was a pretty easy class. Her lectures were super boring though. Easy tests and a pretty fair paper grader
Avoid if you value your sanity and GPA.
she is a great professor. Great discussions, debates and fun topics to talk about. she is pretty harsh with paper gradings, but her tests are fairly easy.
